confirmedIssues.title: Public-key upload uses the wrong JSON field
confirmedIssues.mechanism: UI serializes {pem: pemInput}; handler decodes public_key_pem. With a database available, even a valid nonempty PEM produces an empty decoded PublicKeyPEM and HTTP400 before PEM validation.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: submit a synthetic valid public PEM through Upload key. Expected stored; source contract necessarily takes public_key_pem-is-required branch.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow frontend request-contract correction to public_key_pem, covered by the existing handler contract; preserve PEM on failure.
confirmedIssues.historicalRelation: Backend field implementation was outside the original inventory's verified scope.

confirmedIssues.title: Caught request failures are treated as successful query/mutation resolutions
confirmedIssues.mechanism: apiFetch returns {error} instead of rejecting. Reads replace last valid cache payload with that error object, bypass query retries and retained-data error states. Mutation onSuccess still runs; upload clears controlled PEM input on failed requests, including F01.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: first resolve a config/status read, then reject its refresh; retained fields disappear behind an error banner. Reject upload; onSuccess invalidates status and sets PEM to empty despite failure.
confirmedIssues.needs: One bounded typed-query/mutation integration fix preserving rejection, cancellation, current payloads/query IDs and error surfaces across all helper consumers. Lifecycle changes only on confirmed success.

confirmedIssues.title: Actual Fleet API info falsely renders unauthenticated and no regions
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Handler supplies has_valid_token and a region-name-to-URL object. UI reads authenticated and requires a regions array. camelCaseKeys adds hasValidToken, not authenticated, and does not change object to array. Valid auth therefore renders Not authenticated; regions show dash; onboarding auth cannot auto-detect.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: feed the exact successful handler shape with has_valid_token=true and three regions. Source derives authStatus=false and regions=[], even though base_url/client_id aliases work.
confirmedIssues.needs: One response-contract adapter fix using actual snake_case fields/typed existing FleetSetup contracts, with truthful null/unknown handling. Do not rename unrelated wire fields.

confirmedIssues.title: Public-key location is hidden and pairing URL always uses an example host
confirmedIssues.mechanism: PublicKeyStatus supplies well_known_path/wellKnownPath, not wellKnownUrl, so the actual path is hidden. FleetAPIInfo supplies no hostname, so pairing uses https://tesla.com/_ak/yourapp.example.com, presented as a normal copyable pairing value rather than unknown configuration.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: resolve either exact handler payload. Configured key's well-known path has no rendered branch; pairing remains the example host.
confirmedIssues.needs: One key-address/provenance integration correction. Render actual well-known path; obtain an existing authorized configured hostname or explicitly mark it unknown instead of inventing a production pairing host.

confirmedIssues.title: MQTT topic/message controls cannot affect the advertised publish action
confirmedIssues.mechanism: UI sends entered topic/message; handler never decodes the body and publishes fixed teslasync/dev-tools/ping with a generated timestamp/source payload. A successful result is a connectivity ping, not the requested message.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: enter any synthetic topic and message and inspect dispatch versus handler. Published destination/content stay fixed regardless of both inputs.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow frontend/API semantic alignment: accurately present the existing fixed ping contract or explicitly authorize/implement a validated publish contract; do not silently expand broker capabilities.

confirmedIssues.title: Telemetry tab reports unknown as healthy zero and discards retained tables
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Undefined data defaults to []; unconditional affected badge shows success0 during initial loading/failure. Both isError branches replace previously loaded rows with QueryError. No local stale/paused trust adapter marks retained rows when query fetchStatus is paused.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: render initial pending/failure with no VINs: badge0 affected. Then resolve nonempty data and fail refresh: table replaced. Retained paused query has no local blocked-refresh distinction.
confirmedIssues.needs: One telemetry-tab state fix using per-source useDataState/fatalError and retained warnings/independent retry; never fabricate zero before authoritative empty.
confirmedIssues.historicalRelation: Original audit-page-008 states issue remains; overview correctness does not cover this child.

confirmedIssues.title: VIN changes leave prior result payloads labeled with the new VIN
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Controlled VIN change only calls setVin. Config/errors/delete and vehicle-data mutation results are not reset or bound to submitted VIN. Errors panel receives current VIN for filename while rows remain from the previous query.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: retrieve synthetic vehicle A errors, select synthetic B without another request, then inspect the existing rows/download: A data remains and filename becomes telemetry-errors-B.json. Four vehicle-data actions similarly keep A output under B selection.
confirmedIssues.needs: One response-scope correction: retain submitted VIN/action provenance or reset affected result state on selection change, including in-flight completion ordering and export name.

confirmedIssues.title: Developer-tool writes do not opt into the existing live-mode guard
confirmedIssues.mechanism: requiresLiveMode defaults false and is never passed by apiFetch. assertOperationalWriteAllowed returns immediately when the flag is false; offline defense patterns do not include /dev-tools. DevTools write controls have no local operational-mode condition. The source client therefore does not reject these writes in online as_of mode; offline mutations may pause under TanStack defaults.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: load /dev-tools?as_of=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z with an online environment, activate a key/subscription/MQTT write. Source has no live-only client boundary before request. No actual write or server-authorization conclusion claimed.
confirmedIssues.needs: One exact DevTools live-only boundary fix with visible reason, immediate rejection/no delayed offline writes and preserved query read behavior. Check related Tesla-refresh POSTs explicitly.
confirmedIssues.limitation: Backend authentication remains independent and was not tested; this is not an exploit or an assertion that all server guards are absent.

confirmedIssues.title: Key replacement/deletion and telemetry deletion dispatch immediately
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Click handlers directly call mutate, with no confirmation and no configured-key predicate. Generate uses backend ON CONFLICT replacement, Delete removes singleton public key, and Delete config immediately deletes current selected vehicle's telemetry configuration.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: with a configured key, one Generate/Delete keypair click dispatches replacement/deletion; with VIN selected, one Delete config click dispatches DELETE. No dialog or explicit destructive-context confirmation intervenes in the inspected path.
confirmedIssues.needs: One bounded destructive-action confirmation correction naming real scope/consequences and guarding concurrent destructive operations. Preserve existing server auth; no new privilege capability.

confirmedIssues.title: Subscription and vehicle-data actions dispatch without required selection validation
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Subscribe has no disabled/validation predicate for VIN/hostname/port and serializes vins:[''] initially; invalid port parse can serialize null. Four vehicle-data buttons are enabled with initial vin='', constructing required-vin requests guaranteed to take handler400 branches.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: mount Fleet API tab without choosing a vehicle and inspect enabled Subscribe/vehicle-data controls. Vehicle-data requests contain vin=; subscription carries an empty VIN. Invalid port text reaches serialization with no input error.
confirmedIssues.needs: One local required-input validation/disabled-reason fix, preserving server-authorized hostname defaults and per-signal interval_seconds semantics rather than requiring invented backend fields.

confirmedIssues.title: Visible PEM and CA labels are not associated with their textareas
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Both controls have a nearby span but no label prop, associated htmlFor/id pair or aria-labelledby. Shared Textarea only renders a Label when label is provided. Placeholder fallback is not a programmatic association with the visible label.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: inspect rendered naming inputs under Upload PEM and CA cert. The visible spans reference neither generated textarea ID.
confirmedIssues.needs: One two-field association correction using existing localized Textarea label API; preserve controlled contents and descriptions.

confirmedIssues.title: Unrecognized Tesla error shape still says no errors reported
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Unknown successful payload yields rows=[] and ok=false. Badge changes to ?, but the same authoritative healthy emptyMessage is always rendered; raw disclosure does not retract the no-errors statement.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: resolve errors to a successful object without any recognized errors array. Panel shows ? beside No Fleet Telemetry errors reported for this vehicle.
confirmedIssues.needs: One unknown-shape-versus-authoritative-empty wording/state correction retaining the raw disclosure and real-zero state.

confirmedIssues.title: Onboarding, helper phrases and refresh toasts bypass localization
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Onboarding constant English labels/descriptions render directly; translating the aria-label outer phrase does not translate its label parameter. Cron/relative-time helpers return English text. Refresh success/failure hooks pass literal English to toast.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: use a non-English locale and inspect these code paths: fixed labels/descriptions and helper/toast strings are independent of t/i18n.
confirmedIssues.needs: One scoped localization adoption retaining step IDs/persistence and calculator values, with parent-owned canonical catalog integration. Exhaustive locale/catalog completeness NOTRUN.

confirmedIssues.title: Cron parser accepts five invalid fields and ignores step range/base
confirmedIssues.mechanism: isValid checks only field count. The slash branch discards the range/base and applies value % step to the whole field domain, so 10-20/5 includes minutes0,5,25 and others outside10-20; five garbage tokens enter the valid/no-upcoming-runs branch instead of invalid syntax.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: enter 10-20/5 * * * * or a b c d e and follow parsing predicates. The first loses its range; the second is accepted as valid solely because it has five fields.
confirmedIssues.needs: One bounded existing cron-helper correctness/validation fix preserving presets and next-run count, with direct grammar cases. No helper execution occurred in QA.

confirmedIssues.title: Future timestamps render as time ago
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Math.abs(Date.now()-ms) discards temporal direction and every branch appends ago. Valid future Unix/ISO inputs therefore display a past-tense relative value.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived, NOT EXECUTED: input an ISO instant one hour in the future. Absolute difference takes the1h branch and emits1h ago.
confirmedIssues.needs: One direction-aware localized relative-time correction using existing date/time utilities; keep valid negative Unix epochs and invalid-date guard.

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Five category-only neon icon families and neon gradient are explicit source styling choices, not demonstrated measured contrast failures. Local headings use ad-hoc text classes and SignalConfigModal is imported directly from implementation instead of its category API.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source inspection only: every ToolCard resolves category ICON_COLOR_MAP; wizard progress requests cyan-to-green gradient; modal import directly names the implementation file.
confirmedIssues.needs: After correctness fixes, one narrow local adoption using existing restrained tokens/type roles/category exports. No remodernization, data removal or new component system.
confirmedIssues.historicalRelation: Original audit-page-008 visual/typography/import issues remain; no fresh visual acceptance claimed.
